title.rendered: The Top Hair Growth Devices of 2023

content.rendered:
Hair growth devices using low-level light therapy (LLLT) have become increasingly popular as a hair loss treatment. The National Library of Medicine did a study on the effectiveness of low-level light therapy, and found that it stimulated hair growth in both men and women.They have the convenience of being able to be used from anywhere, easy to carry around, provide clinical strength laser therapy, are FDA approved and offer quick, easy and painless treatments.  They also cost a fraction of the price you would pay going to a laser therapy clinic or hair transplant surgeon. 

There are a handful of laser therapy devices that are on the market today. They differ in coverage, diodes of laser power, price and wearability. These devices include:

Laser Helmets

These are the original hands-free laser therapy devices. They are exactly what they say, helmets. They are effective, using 51 to 282 diodes of laser power. However, they work better for people who don’t have a lot of hair to start with because they need to be able to allow the laser to reach the scalp. They are usually not used in public or on the go because of how they are designed to look. 

Laser Caps

Laser caps look like regular baseball caps. They have the capability similar to helmets with the diodes of laser power. They allow a more natural look while they are in use because they appear as regular accessories and they only take 30 minutes for each session. 

Laser Combs

Combs are more affordable when it comes to LLLT devices because they are small and don’t provide full coverage at all times. They do require manual operation. With combs you can massage your scalp wherever you may need.

Laser Bands

Bands look like headbands with teeth. They are similar to helmets and caps but like combs, do not cover the entire scalp at any given time. They do offer more diodes than combs, but less than helmets and caps. They are also more noticeable than caps but lightweight and travel-friendly. 

Which is right for me?

With the hair growth devices listed above you may be wondering, which one is the right choice for me? Well, if you want something that is lightweight, easy to use, uses clinically proven technology, has great coverage and looks like something that you would already be wearing, a laser cap might just be for you. 

Why choose the Kiierr Laser Cap?

There’s a reason laser caps are one of the top choices for at home hair growth devices. Being one of the market’s leaders in laser caps is Kiierr’s mission. Kiierr was founded by husband-and-wife team, Mike and Jolene Anderson, with the purpose of helping those who suffer from hair loss. Kiierr’s laser cap brings the benefits of LLLT to your door with FDA clearance and a warranty to back it up. With an outstanding product and great customer service staff, you will be taken care of from the second you interact with us. Get one of our laser caps today and start your journey to get your hair back.  

Author Bio

 Jolene Anderson is the proud Co-Founder of Kiierr Hair Growth Experts. She has 11 years experience in natural healing, laser therapy hair loss. She’s a caring mom of 2 and passionate about helping others. Connect with her on LinkedIn: Jolene Anderson – Co-Founder @ Kiierr.com
